name: folk
description: folk lets agents search and update people, companies, notes, and deals in the signed-in folk workspace. Each user signs in to their own folk account through the browser.

prompts.text: Find the people at Acme in my folk workspace and when I last talked to them.
Add a note to Jane Doe's folk profile about today's intro call.
Which deals have had no activity for more than 30 days?

apps.name: folk
apps.description: People, company, note, and deal access, over folk's MCP server with browser sign-in.
